title: Latest botched execution prompts calls for US moratorium on lethal injections
summary_full: Reinaldo Dennes screamed in pain and took over an hour to die – but Texas officials branded the execution a successA botched execution in Texas on Thursday night that lasted more than an hour and caused the prisoner to scream out, begging the Lord to end his suffering, has led to renewed calls for a nationwide moratorium that would pause all lethal injections.It took 63 minutes for Reinaldo Dennes, 70, to be proclaimed dead in the Huntsville penitentiary. The execution team had struggled to find a vein through which a lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital could be administered. Continue reading...
